The Opportunity:

We are looking for an Incentive Compensation Systems Manager to join our Incentive Compensation (IC) team and drive the systemization, automation, and continuous improvement of our commission operations. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, reporting to the Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation. To be successful, you should look forward to operating in an unstructured, fast-paced, remote-first environment where you will identify gaps in existing processes, replace manual workarounds with scalable systems, and bring greater predictability, accuracy, and speed to how the business manages commissions, quotas, and comp plan administration.

In this role, you will gain deep exposure to how incentive compensation data flows end-to-end from our CRM (e.g., SFDC), People systems (e.g., Workday) through calculation engines (e.g., Xactly) to payout and reporting (e.g., BigQuery). You'll be the person the team turns to when a process is slow, fragile, or held together by spreadsheets. You will partner closely with our Incentive Compensation Operations Team, Finance & Strategy, People Ops, and RevOps orgs to understand how work actually gets done today, find the friction points, and build the tooling and workflows that remove them. This role requires a unique balance: enough technical depth to design and build real automation, combined with the process discipline and cross-functional judgment to know which problems are worth solving first.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Process & Gap Assessment: Embed with the IC team to map current-state workflows across plan administration, calculation, approvals, and payout. Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone steps and prioritize them based on risk, time cost, and business impact.
  • Systematization & Automation: Design and build automated workflows, integrations, and tooling that replace manual processes from data pulls and reconciliations to approval routing and exception handling. Reduce reliance on ad-hoc spreadsheets and one-off scripts in favor of durable, repeatable systems.
  • Xactly ICM Ownership: Serve as a hands-on owner of our Xactly instances (e.g., Incent and Connect) configuring calculation rules, plan logic, and workflows, and continuously tuning the platform so it does more of the heavy lifting currently done manually outside the system.
  • AI-Enabled Process Automation: Identify where AI tools and LLM-driven agents can take over manual, repetitive Incentive Compensation work such as exception detection, data reconciliation, plan document review, or answering common comp questions and build the workflows/integrations to put them into production.
  • Systems Integration: Partner with IC, Finance & Strategy, People Ops, Revenue Operations, and IT/Data teams to ensure incentive compensation systems are properly integrated, with clean, reliable data flowing between them.
  • Documentation & Governance: Establish clear documentation, standard operating procedures, and controls for newly systematized processes, so they're auditable, maintainable, and don't regress back into manual work over time.
  • Continuous Improvement Cadence: Set up a repeatable process for the IC team to keep identifying and retiring manual work, as an ongoing discipline of finding the next bottleneck and fixing it.
  • Cross-Functional Enablement: Act as the go-to resource translating IC process needs into system requirements, and translating system/data constraints back into practical process recommendations the team can act on.
  • Operational Excellence: Support urgent, ad-hoc requests during payout cycles while keeping an eye on the long-term goal. Building yourself out of the fire-fighting role by systemizing the fixes.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in incentive compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, or a related systems/process improvement role. Experience in a fast-paced technology or SaaS business is highly preferred.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: A demonstrated track record of finding manual, broken, or inefficient processes and systematizing them, not just documenting problems but building the solution.
  • SQL & Data Fluency: Hands-on SQL experience and comfort querying and reconciling data across systems to diagnose process gaps and validate automated outputs.
  • Automation & Tooling: Hands-on experience building automated workflows using tools such as scripting, workflow/RPA platforms, or ICM systems (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, SPIFF platforms). Comfort standing up lightweight tools or integrations when off-the-shelf options fall short.
  • Systems Fluency: Familiarity with the core systems that touch incentive compensation: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), HRIS, data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery), and comp management platforms (e.g., Xactly) understanding how data moves between them.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Strong communication skills, with the ability to sit with a team, understand how they actually work day-to-day, and translate that into clear systems requirements and process changes.
  • Analytical Rigor: Understanding of core comp mechanics (quotas, accelerators, SPIFFs, payout timing) sufficient to spot where a process breaks down or introduces risk.

Bonus Points For:

  • Industry & Scale Context: Experience working in a high-growth SaaS, cloud, or open-source company, particularly within a public company or an environment undergoing IPO readiness.
  • Global Collaboration: Proven success working within globally distributed, remote-first organizations across multiple time zones.
  • AI & LLM-Driven Automation: Experience documenting datasets and workflows for Model Context Protocol (MCP) server ingestion, or building AI skills/agents to automate incentive compensation data discovery, exception detection, or reporting.

jobs.description:
Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.

Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano.

Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar.

Sobre o Time

O Jurídico da Zippi está em um momento especialmente interessante de construção. Somos um time enxuto, responsável por apoiar o crescimento de uma fintech que opera em um ambiente jurídico complexo e regulado.

Com a expansão da Zippi, o volume e a diversidade das demandas jurídicas também cresceram — e estamos estruturando o time para acompanhar esse próximo capítulo. Isso significa que quem entrar agora encontrará uma área ainda em formação, com proximidade das decisões, exposição a diferentes frentes jurídicas e espaço real para ajudar a construir processos, nossa operação e formas de trabalhar desde cedo.

Sua Missão

Sua missão será se tornar uma peça-chave na construção da operação jurídica da Zippi, começando por três frentes centrais — contencioso, contratos e suporte consultivo às áreas internas — e ganhando autonomia progressiva sobre elas.

No dia a dia, você vai acompanhar uma carteira de processos cíveis e consumeristas em parceria com nosso escritório externo — incluindo o acompanhamento de casos junto a órgãos como PROCON e —, conduzir contratos comerciais de menor complexidade do início ao fim e apoiar times como Produto, Operações e People na resolução de dúvidas jurídicas recorrentes.

Mais do que executar essas rotinas, esperamos que você ajude a torná-las cada vez mais organizadas, eficientes e escaláveis: estruturando controles, acompanhando métricas, identificando lacunas e propondo melhorias nos processos em operação — inclusive com uso de IA e automações para reduzir trabalho manual e ganhar escala.

À medida que ganha domínio e autonomia nessas frentes, existe espaço para ampliar sua atuação para temas como trabalhista, compliance, privacidade e projetos de automação, construindo uma visão generalista do Jurídico de uma fintech em crescimento e assumindo progressivamente novas responsabilidades dentro do time.

O que buscamos:

  • OAB ativa (ou fase final de obtenção, ex.: aprovado(a) no exame aguardando emissão do número).
  • Base em contencioso cível: experiência elaborando subsídios/peças, acompanhando prazos processuais e organizando documentação, idealmente com responsabilidade sobre uma carteira, ainda que pequena.
  • Experiência emrevisão de contratos: prestação de serviços, NDAs, aditivos ou fornecedores.
  • Autonomia operacional: resolve e sinaliza proativamente quando trava, sem depender de instrução passo a passo — inclusive para identificar e apontar gaps ou inconsistências por conta própria.
  • Boa capacidade de execução: entende e se interessa por um escopo majoritariamente prático.
  • Curiosidade e iniciativa para usar IA e automações na melhoria de fluxos e rotinas jurídicas, buscando reduzir trabalho manual e tornar os processos mais eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas jurídicas (Elaw, DocuSign/ZapSign, Notion) ou facilidade para se adaptar a elas

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Exposição a trabalhista/People (contratos CLT/PJ, rescisões, políticas internas);
  • Familiaridade com temas de compliance, KYC/AML ou LGPD.
  • Contexto prévio em empresa regulada (fintech, crédito, meios de pagamento);
  • Experiência em consultivo interno a áreas de negócio (Produto, Operações, Comercial, People);
  • Regulatório Bacen/CVM/FIDC

Por que vir para a Zippi?

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar: nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia: como early team member, você terá papel essencial na evolução e construção do Jurídico de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada por investidores de renome como Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Globo Ventures e Volpe Capital.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa: aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta.

O que você pode esperar da gente!

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros(as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;
  • Vale-refeição no Caju;
  • Férias flexíveis;
  • Wellhub e Zenklub;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto.

DataDome is looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our US team.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will partner with Account Executives and prospective customers to define technical strategy, uncover business and security challenges, and demonstrate how DataDome can protect critical digital experiences.

You will own the technical motion across discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, proof-of-value exercises, security reviews, and technical close. You will work with security, engineering, infrastructure, and executive stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, leading customer conversations, and becoming a trusted technical advisor throughout the buying process.

DataDome delivers real-time bot and agent trust management, giving businesses complete visibility and control over all traffic—human, bot, or AI. Named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Bot And Agent Trust Management Q2 2026, DataDome is trusted by enterprises like Etsy, PayPal, and Soundcloud. Acting as a traffic control plane, DataDome's multi-layered AI engine leverages thousands of models and 5 trillion signals daily to analyze intent and stop fraud in under 2 milliseconds—letting legitimate users through seamlessly across websites, apps, APIs, and MCPs. Backed by a 24/7 SOC and expert threat researchers, DataDome stops 20k+ attacks every second. With 30+ global PoPs, and 80+ ready-made integrations, DataDome is a recognized Leader on G2 across several categories—delivering protection that outperforms.

What you will do

  • Own the technical strategy for mid-market and enterprise opportunities from discovery through technical close.
  • Understand customer business challenges, security priorities, application architecture, traffic flows, and success criteria.
  • Lead technical discovery and architecture discussions with engineering, security, infrastructure, and executive stakeholders.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling product demonstrations, workshops, technical presentations, and proof-of-value exercises.
  • Design and validate DataDome deployment approaches across web, mobile, API, CDN, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Guide prospects through technical evaluations, integrations, testing, security reviews, and production-readiness discussions.
  • Configure and analyze trial environments to validate DataDome’s detection and mitigation capabilities.
  • Analyze traffic, logs, detection outcomes, and customer requirements to recommend effective solutions.
  • Partner closely with Account Management, Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and Marketing.
  • Help identify and overcome technical, security, and business objections.
  • Capture customer feedback and translate it into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
  • Contribute to Solutions Engineering enablement by creating reusable demos, technical content, discovery frameworks, and competitive guidance.
  • Help mentor other Solutions Engineers and raise the quality and consistency of the team’s customer-facing work.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles within SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, networking, developer tooling, or a related technology environment.
  • A track record of leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proof-of-value exercises, and security or architecture reviews.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, HTTP, APIs, networking, cloud architecture, CDNs, reverse proxies, and modern application infrastructure.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong consultative selling skills and experience handling technical, security, and business objections.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate with senior technical and executive stakeholders.

Candidates with 3+ years of relevant experience may also be considered if they have demonstrated ownership of complex enterprise evaluations, strong executive presence, and the ability to operate independently.

Bonus points for experience with

  • Cybersecurity, bot management, fraud prevention, WAF, DDoS protection, CDN, observability, or application performance.
  • Kibana, Elasticsearch, Grafana, or similar log analysis and observability tools.
  • Apache, Nginx, Varnish, IIS, Lambda@Edge, CloudFront, or similar web and edge technologies.
  • Mobile applications, APIs, or multi-cloud and multi-CDN environments.
  • Working with security, fraud, infrastructure, or digital experience teams.

What’s in it for you?

  • Fully remote position (US-based) with the flexibility to work from anywhere in+ $500 stipend to help you set up your ideal home workspace.
  • Health Benefits: We offer medical, dental, & vision insurance options to keep you feeling your best.
  • A $100 annual allowance is provided for a leisure activity of your choice in Sports.
  • Professional Development: #Weaimhigh is part of our DNA, therefore we have invested in an internal Learning and Development platform and offer the opportunity to request additional training and support via your manager.
  • Events & Team building: #We care and we have fun! We organize ****Annual Company-Offsite, Events, Drinks, Winter Party, Lunch & Learns and much more are part of our Culture
  • Parent Care: Gifts & care packages to celebrate growing families.
  • PTO: 20 paid time off days, 5 sick days and 2 floating holidays ****+ 12 national holidays.
  • 401 K eligibility + matching.

What are the next steps?

Our interview process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet key members of the team and demonstrate how you approach technical customer challenges.

  1. Introductory conversation with a Talent Acquisition Manager.
  2. Interview with the Solutions Engineering Manager, focused on your experience, technical depth, and customer approach.
  3. Practical case exercise involving a DataDome integration and customer-facing technical presentation.
  4. Final one-on-one conversation with our CEO.

The practical exercise will evaluate your ability to understand a technical product, explain how it is deployed, adapt to different stakeholders, and connect technical capabilities to customer outcomes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
Location: Remote (UK or Europe) Department: Product & Technology

The Opportunity

This role is for someone who shapes what's worth building, designs it by building, and owns the result in production. You explore and prototype like a designer, then carry the strong ideas all the way to a shipped front-end - one craft, not two stages with a handoff between them.

When the same person designs and builds, there's no spec to hand off and no rebuild cycle: the work moves faster and the original intent survives. You'll sit in a product squad alongside software engineers who own the systems beneath the experience. They're accountable for whether it runs; you're accountable for what it is.

Most of what gets called "AI in product" is a button bolted onto an unchanged screen. Our client is building the opposite: experiences where the agent does the work and the human reviews, corrects, and authorises it. Knowing the difference - and being able to ship it - is the judgment we're hiring for.

What You'll Do

  • Explore and prototype to find the right answer. Most of what you make is for learning, not shipping. Production is where the right answer lands, not where it starts.
  • Carry features through to the production front-end. The design decision and the code are the same job, in the same hands.
  • Help frame what's worth building. Talk to users, pressure-test problems, and shape scope with your squad rather than waiting for a finished spec.
  • Build the supervisory surfaces of an agent-native platform: a triage queue an underwriter trusts at a glance, a confidence and citation pattern they can act on, a briefing that replaces a dashboard.
  • Use AI across the full loop - research, design, prototype, build, test - as the default way you work, applying real judgment to its output rather than trusting it.
  • Own the invisible craft: performance, accessibility, cross-device behaviour, and the responsiveness that makes an interface feel fast.

What We're Looking For

  • A builder who designs and ships front-end to production. You've owned a problem, made the call on what the experience should be, and shipped it yourself.
  • Design judgment and taste. When AI produces competent interfaces instantly, telling good from merely functional is the scarce skill.
  • Product instinct. You can cut scope without being told to and validate with real users rather than waiting for certainty.
  • Fluency in a modern web codebase, with AI tooling at every stage. You know AI's failure modes and can tell when output looks right but isn't. We care that you can ship and know when it's right, not which framework you came up on.
  • The ability to design data-rich, high-stakes interfaces for demanding professionals, and to converse credibly with seasoned insurance experts.

There's no single right background - strong candidates come from design, from engineering, and from places in between. If you design and you build and you can ship both well, we want to talk.

jobs.description:
🚨 READ THIS FIRST

No Easy Apply. No AI.

This is not a typical “content” role.

This role is a health and medical video scriptwriter/storyteller with some interview-driven producing experience.

If your experience is more of a field producer / post producer hybrid with some medical scriptwriting/storytelling experience, consider applying for this role:

Why This Role Matters

The stories we tell influence:

· whether patients seek treatment

· how quickly clinicians adopt new technology

· how efficiently life-changing therapies reach the people who need them

The right fit for this role has experience in:

· understanding complex medical science quickly

· thinking critically

· connecting deeply with patients and clinicians

· turning those connections into creatively engaging, interview-driven videos

Who We Are…

We are an award-winning B2B creative video agency specializing in medtech and pharma. We create branded, documentary-style interview-driven video content aimed at clinicians, patients, and employees.

Our core focus is to help patients get access to the life-changing medical innovations they need through our engaging, authentic storytelling.

Our big, hairy, audacious goal? Help bring 150 life-changing medical innovations to patients who need them by 2034. And everyone on our team is deeply committed to the cause with team tenure ranging from four years to eleven years!

What This Role Actually Is

You are the internal subject matter expert and narrative lead on each project.

This is a client facing role where you develop and own the story end-to-end — from needs assessment, pre-script writing, pre-production, on set interviews, through post production and editing.

You are responsible for shaping the narrative before the shoot, directing and adapting it in real time during interviews, and ensuring the story comes together clearly and accurately in the final edit.

Approximately 60% of this role focuses on clinician-facing content and 40% on patient-centered storytelling.

You will:

· Listen to clients explain their business problem and learn as much as you can about the medical innovation and disease states they support

· Learn from clinicians who explain how they use the innovation, which features and benefits matter to them, and how it benefits patients.

· Interview patients with compassion and understanding of their unique situations

· Speak and write in a way that earns respect and understanding from clinicians as well as be able to switch gears/TOV into patient-facing storytelling, depending on the audience.

What We’re Really Looking For

You are someone who:

· Understands and has some end-to-end experience with the corporate/branded documentary film production process

· Can quickly learn complex medical and engineering innovation topics and explain them clearly

· Is both analytical and emotionally intelligent

· Is outgoing and warm, comfortable engaging in conversations with clients, experts, and patients alike

· Has demonstrated the ability write compelling interview-driven scripts.

· Thrives in ambiguity and can create structure

What You’ll Do

This role requires ownership across the full storytelling lifecycle:

1.) Learn Fast, Go Deep

  • Independently research and synthesize complex medical topics—often with limited public information—so you can engage clients and clinicians as a credible, informed partner from the very first conversation

2.) Discovery & Client Partnership

  • Lead early discovery conversations with clients to understand the business problem

  • Translate client goals into clear storytelling strategies

3. Shape the Story Concept Before Production

Work with clients to define:

  • audiences (clinicians/patients/employees)

  • messaging

  • creative strategy

  • Conduct in-depth pre-interviews to uncover emotional truth, narrative arcs, and key story beats—not just facts

  • In a pre-script, layout the story structure, dialogue and visual opportunities that will make an audience care

  • Work with production team to spec visuals (b-roll and graphics) and to ensure scripts can be executed by the production team within the budget and timeline

4. Lead Interviews On Set

  • Conduct on-camera interviews

  • Charm patients and clinicians to help them be their best on camera

  • Gather content that closely matches the pre-script, plus extra unexpected goodies

5. Create the Narrative

  • Turn interviews into video scripts that match the creative brief, balancing emotional truth, clinical accuracy, and regulatory guidelines

  • Work with producers and post-production team to ensure content stays on brief through final delivery

  • Support the editorial process to completion with your subject matter expertise, keeping the client’s interests in mind.

You May Come From

· Healthcare or science journalism (patient or clinician storytelling)

· Medical communications, MedTech or pharma marketing, or clinical communications

· Healthcare-focused PR (especially within MedTech or pharma)

· Non-fiction or interview-driven storytelling (with exposure to complex subject matter)

Must-Haves

· Experience working in healthcare, medtech, pharma, or clinical environments

· Proven ability to learn complex topics fast and explain them succinctly

· Strong writing + storytelling ability

· Experience interviewing patients and clinicians Meticulous communication and thinking—able to operate in highly regulated environments where precision, accuracy, and professionalism are non-negotiable

· High attention to detail

· Willingness to travel

Bonus Points

· Experience navigating legal, medical or compliance guidelines in regulated content environments

Not a Fit If Your Experience is Limited to:

· Creating content for broad, B2C audiences rather than crafting stories for highly targeted, expert audiences with defined needs

· Scripted narrative content

· Reality TV

What Success Looks Like

· You can hold and navigate depth across multiple complex projects simultaneously—quickly getting up to speed, retaining critical details, and switching between projects without losing accuracy or context

· Concepts are strategically grounded and well-researched, using clinical evidence, audience insight, and thoughtful pre-interviews to support the client’s goals

· Content remains on brief throughout the project lifecycle, accurately reflecting the client’s messaging strategy and objectives from concept through final delivery

· Pre-interviews and interviews are conducted with professionalism and high emotional intelligence, resulting in authentic, engaging stories that align with both patient experience and client intent

· Scripts clearly and effectively deliver on messaging targets, integrating clinical accuracy and patient/clinician perspective while staying true to approved positioning and tone

· Patients and clinicians feel respected and supported, and clinician audiences find the content credible, relevant, and worth their time

Details

· We’ll train you in the Authentica Way, but you need strong instincts and experience coming in with the desire to get the job done using Authentica’s process.

· 40 hr/week contract → potential full-time

· Must work PST/MST hours

· Salary is $70,000—$100,000/year, DOE

jobs.excerpt: Scrum Master – AI DeliveryAbout the RoleNimble Gravity is looking for an experienced Scrum Master – AI Delivery to help drive predictable, high-quality delivery across complex AI and technology initiatives.
jobs.description:
Scrum Master – AI Delivery

About the Role

Nimble Gravity is looking for an experienced Scrum Master – AI Delivery to help drive predictable, high-quality delivery across complex AI and technology initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong Agile leadership with hands-on project management skills and is comfortable working across technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership.

You will help teams stay focused, remove blockers, manage dependencies and risks, and create visibility into delivery progress — while continuously improving how teams plan and execute their work.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Agile ceremonies across one or more AI or technology delivery teams, including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.

  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, Data, and AI teams to ensure priorities and sprint goals are clear and realistic.

  • Own delivery planning, milestone tracking, dependencies, risks, issues, and overall project coordination.

  • Identify and remove blockers across teams, including technical dependencies, data access, integrations, security reviews, and shared services.

  • Track delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, cycle time, and unplanned work to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.

  • Protect sprint commitments and help teams manage changing priorities without losing delivery focus.

  • Coordinate work across multiple teams, stakeholders, and external partners when needed.

  • Provide clear visibility into project status, risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines.

  • Communicate progress and potential issues clearly to both technical teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement initiatives to improve delivery predictability, collaboration, and quality.

  • Coach teams on Agile best practices while encouraging accountability, ownership, and effective collaboration.

  • Support project governance and executive-level reporting across AI initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in Scrum Master, Agile Delivery, Project Management, or similar roles.

  • Experience working with technical, data, AI, or software engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and Scrum practices.

  • Solid project management skills, including planning, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder communication.

  • Experience managing multiple projects, teams, or workstreams simultaneously.

  • Strong facilitation, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to identify blockers and proactively drive them toward resolution.

  • Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and communicating delivery status, risks, and trade-offs.

  • Experience using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving environments where priorities can evolve quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting AI, Machine Learning, Data, or Analytics initiatives.

  • Experience working in consulting or client-facing environments.

  • Experience working in regulated industries or complex enterprise environments.

  • PMP, CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or similar Agile/Project Management certification.

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

What Success Looks Like

You bring structure without slowing teams down. You anticipate risks before they become blockers, keep stakeholders aligned, and help technical teams deliver consistently.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking the right questions, and taking ownership of delivery — not just facilitating meetings.

At Nimble Gravity, we value people who are proactive, collaborative, adaptable, and willing to jump in wherever needed to help the team get things across the finish line.

About Nimble Gravity

Nimble Gravity is a team of outdoor enthusiasts, adrenaline seekers, and experienced growth hackers. We love solving hard problems and believe the right data can transform and propel growth for any organization.

Nimble Gravity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Nimble Gravity considers all qualified applicants.

jobs.description:
Pay: $160,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • Lead complex labor and employment matters from intake through resolution while serving as a trusted strategic advisor to clients.
  • Join a mission-driven employment law team focused on meaningful outcomes, client advocacy, and positive change.
  • Enjoy true remote flexibility while practicing anywhere in North Carolina with an active NC bar license.
  • Take on a leadership role with opportunities to mentor attorneys and legal staff and help shape case strategy.
  • Build your practice and business development opportunities, with bonus potential tied to revenue and originated matters.
  • Work alongside a collaborative, empathetic team that values both professional excellence and life outside of work.

Location: Remote anywhere in North Carolina. You can work from the location that best supports your productivity and lifestyle while remaining closely connected with our team and clients.

Note: An active North Carolina bar license and 5+ years of directly relevant labor and employment law experience are must-haves for this role. Candidates should have meaningful experience handling employment litigation, counseling, and dispute resolution.

About Us

We are a mission-driven employment law practice dedicated to leveling the playing field for employees and delivering meaningful outcomes with integrity and empathy. Our team values collaboration, leadership, diversity, innovation, and genuine respect for one another. We believe great legal work and a great workplace go hand in hand. Confidential Employer.

Job Description

  • Lead complex labor and employment matters from initial intake through resolution.
  • Develop and execute litigation strategies tailored to each client's goals and circumstances.
  • Advise clients on a broad range of employment law issues with clear, practical, and business-minded guidance.
  • Conduct sophisticated legal research and analyze statutes, regulations, case law, and emerging employment law developments.
  • Draft and review pleadings, motions, briefs, agreements, correspondence, and other legal documents.
  • Negotiate settlements, participate in dispute resolution, and advocate effectively for favorable client outcomes.
  • Manage case strategy and coordinate effectively with attorneys, legal staff, and other internal resources.
  • Mentor and provide leadership to legal team members while maintaining high standards of quality and client service.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with clients through responsive communication and thoughtful legal counsel.
  • Contribute to business development, practice growth, and broader firm initiatives.
  • Help advance a culture centered on collaboration, empathy, integrity, diversity, and innovation.

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school.
  • Active North Carolina bar license.
  • 5+ years of labor and employment law experience.
  • Strong employment litigation experience, including case management, pleadings, motions, discovery, negotiations, and dispute resolution.
  • Experience providing employment law counseling and practical legal advice.
  • Excellent legal research, writing, negotiation, and oral advocacy skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex matters independently and strategically.
  • Leadership, mentoring, or legal team management experience preferred.
  • Strong client-service mindset and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Commitment to client-centered advocacy, collaboration, and inclusive workplace values.

Why You Will Love Working Here

You will have the opportunity to practice at a high level without giving up the flexibility that matters in your life. Our team combines sophisticated employment law work with a genuinely collaborative and supportive culture. You will have room to lead, mentor others, grow your practice, develop business, and make a meaningful impact for clients while working remotely anywhere in North Carolina. The role offers a $110,000 base salary plus performance-based bonuses, with total compensation of $160,000–$200,000 and additional upside for originated cases.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Regulatory & PV Network
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Specialist, Regulatory and PV Network is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for driving regulatory and PV deliverables based on an established PV and regulatory plan.
jobs.description:
The Senior Specialist, Regulatory and PV Network is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for driving regulatory and PV deliverables based on an established PV and regulatory plan. They also serve as a liaison between regulatory and other functional areas including external partners, clients, authorities and/or consultants in the planning, organizing, and preparing of regulatory deliverables following project, corporate and industry regulatory strategies.

The Senior Specialist will also act as Local Contact Person for Pharmacovigilance for the designated country.

Job Responsibilities

  • Act as Local Contact Person for Pharmacovigilance for the designated country
  • Assume leadership and functional representation for projects of medium/high complexity ensuring effective and rapid coordination and management of regulatory deliverables, driving the team to meet the agreed targets and to comply with the agreed procedures, trackers and templates
  • With the help of a senior member of the team, develop strategy and manage set up activities (Project Management Plan, joint operating procedures, POAs and core documents)
  • Provide strategic input to internal and external customers and promptly identify and address any risk/potential risk by implementing preventive measures
  • Problem solve and support achievement of satisfactory resolution of performance issues or delivery failures
  • Collect, review, track and maintain LCPs' CVs, job descriptions, training records, contact details and monthly reports
  • Ensure correct training assignment to and training compliance by the LCPs
  • Ensure all team members assigned to the project for departmental deliverables are aware of the tasks and time allocated, monitor project budgets, hours spent vs budgeted and promptly identify and escalate any OoS
  • Provide support to proposal development and input to budgets, provide department representation to BD meetings as required
  • Prepare client’s invoices and review/approve vendors’ project invoices
  • Provide training, coaching and mentoring to junior members of staff
  • Foster professional working relationships with internal and external contacts at the local and international levels to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery
  • Stay abreast of changing regulatory legislative requirements and ensure maintenance of the regulatory intelligence database and timely dissemination of pertinent changes
  • Participate in and/or support junior members in preparation for audits/inspections and provide department representation for assigned projects as required
  • Track LCPs' key performance indicators and prepare monthly summary reports
  • Provide feedback on performance of vendors to aid their assessment
  • Provide input to department / company initiatives and contribute to the design/review of SOPs/working practice/guidance.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry or Life Sciences, Nursing, or equivalent experience
  • Strong experience within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory body
  • Good knowledge of ICH GCP and/or GVP and national regulations for territories of competency
  • PV training and/or working experience and other educational or professional background as required locally
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal
  • Candidate must be proficient in the official language of the country in which they are based, as this is essential for local interactions and compliance
  • Good planning and organizational skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline oriented, and changing environment
  • Good attention to detail

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
characteristics

  • Fixed-term employment contract (initially for two years)
  • Full-time
  • Fully remote from Germany or abroad (German working hours) or hybrid from Hanover, Munich or Leipzig
  • Published on 21.08.2026
  • Application deadline: 31.12.2026
  • Earliest start date: 01.08.2027
  • Teaching load of 18 SWS

about us

velpTEC is an education institute focused on innovative technologies, combining experience from business, future studies, and new educational approaches. Through our educational offerings, we support people in strengthening their skills for the future in a practice-oriented way, helping them actively shape their own paths in life – and from 2027 onward, also in higher education.
VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) is a private university of applied sciences currently undergoing the process of state recognition through the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture. Our degree programs are launching in the fields of digital technologies, engineering, and innovation-driven management – with a clear commitment to continuously expanding our portfolio and responding to new developments. We understand teaching as a space for shaping solutions for tomorrow. Our approach is project-based, competency-oriented, and closely interlinked with practice. We are looking for individuals who are eager to break new ground in higher education and want to actively help shape our innovative learning environment.
We are filling a W2-Professorship in Design Foundations and Visual Communication (100 %).

your responsibilities

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Bachelor's program in Future Design and Immersive Systems, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on design fundamentals, visual communication, branding and human-centered design in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and bachelor's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of visual communication, design methodology, and human-centered design – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration

recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):
  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of design, visual communication, design research or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in design, visual communication, branding, or creative direction roles in industry

in addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.

in addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in design fundamentals and visual communication education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to design and visual communication
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate international design and communication perspectives into teaching and research.
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in visual communication, design methodology, or human-centered design
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society

what we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote from Germany or abroad (German working hours) or hybrid from Hanover, Munich or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours with core working hours – medical appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are no problem
  • Fixed salary + performance-based bonus + €100 per month (for full-time employees) towards a company pension plan after 6 months + 15% employer contribution to your own payments + attractive employee discounts
  • 1 additional day of paid leave per year for volunteering
  • Annual health budget of €600 (for full-time employees) after 6 months + access to more than 13,000 fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation

application documents and further information

  • Please submit your application, together with the required documents, in English via our online portal. You can access the online portal through the "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" button. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by post or email.
  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *:
    • *Cover letter
    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities
    • *List of publications and, where applicable, presentations
    • If applicable, list of third-party funding acquisitions
    • If applicable, list of international experience and cooperations
  • Application documents must be submitted as scans. Please use the upload fields provided in the online portal. For your cover letter, use the "Anschreiben" upload; for your CV, use the "Lebenslauf" upload; and for your employment references, use the "Arbeitszeugnis" upload. For all other documents, please use the "Andere" upload.
  • The recognition of foreign educational qualifications requires proof of equivalence. Initial points of contact can be found via the portal www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de or
  • Equal opportunity and diversity are actively promoted and practiced at VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung). This position is explicitly open to people of all genders (m/f/d). Applications from female scientists are expressly welcomed.
  • Application costs will not be reimbursed.
In the further course of the appointment procedure, candidates may be asked, upon request, to give a teaching session, outline a research project, and complete at least one interview.
By submitting your application documents, you consent to them being forwarded to the Appointment Committee. Within the appointment procedure, certain persons/committee members have the right to inspect the documents. These include members of the Presidential Board, the Senate, the University Council, and the Appointment Committee, as well as the sponsoring institution (velpTEC GmbH). Furthermore, the Officer for Equality and Diversity, where applicable the Officer for (Severe) Disability, and the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture have the right to inspect the application documents. Application documents submitted to VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) are handled in accordance with data protection requirements and are used and stored exclusively for the purposes of the appointment procedure. They will not be passed on to third parties. Upon conclusion of the appointment procedure, the application documents will be destroyed in compliance with the relevant data protection requirements. For any data protection questions, the data protection officers of velpTEC GmbH () are happy to assist you.

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact.

Role Overview

ServiceNow’s Security Incident Command (SIC) team is seeking an experienced senior security incident commander to join our fast-growing team. This role will support the orchestration of incident response strategy and communications during critical information security-related incidents.

About the SIC team

The SIC team maintains and executes the Major Security Incidents (MSI) lifecycle within ServiceNow, including Preparation, Response, and Recovery. MSIs are our most challenging and impactful security incidents which pose active or heightened risk to the company and/or our customers.

Key value areas are preparing the company for MSIs through tabletop exercises (TTX), coordination of activity between many response workstream partners, maintenance and development of playbooks and procedures, tracking key MSI metrics and facts to keep everyone oriented, and communicating status, milestones, blockers, and critical decisions needed to senior management and executive stakeholders, including the CISO.

What you get to do in this role

  • Orchestration of response and remediation of incident response for highest criticality security events. 
  • Take ownership and lead response to critical incidents within the company.
  • Establish and mature documentation surrounding protocols and procedures governing the security incident command team.
  • Prepare and deliver communications, including executive summaries and incident briefings, to key stakeholders during and after incident response. 
  • Conduct rapid response, mitigation, and investigations on the highest priority cases impacting ServiceNow and user data. 
  • Partner with the team members across multiple regions to drive response and investigations globally. 
  • Organization and facilitation of scenario-based exercises to test and improve incident management and response strategies.
  • Maintenance of existing playbooks and procedures, as well as developing new ones, to further standardize SIC and its partners' responses when verifying MSIs.
  • Contribute to the organization and completion of Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) following major security incidents.
  • Identify new ways to simplify, integrate, automate and refine the major security incident process to better support internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 8+ years of total cybersecurity professional experience, or similar experience with education
  • 4–6+ years of deep domain expertise in incident response and/or incident management
  • Experience leading or supporting complex security incidents to resolution end-to-end. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English)
  • Comfort communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences (highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Ability to quickly and accurately assess a situation, identify and prioritize risks, and make sound decision
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles and frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK). 
  • Knowledge across multiple security domains is a plus. 
  • Experience planning and/or orchestrating tabletop exercises is a plus.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.excerpt: About usTruffle Security is a cybersecurity company on a mission to make secrets easier to detect, verify, and remediate across modern software environments.
jobs.description:
About us

Truffle Security is a cybersecurity company on a mission to make secrets easier to detect, verify, and remediate across modern software environments. Built on the popular open-source TruffleHog™ secrets scanning platform, the company's enterprise solution gives security and engineering teams everything they need to find exposed credentials, understand which ones are active, and act on them with confidence.

With support for 800+ credential types, Truffle Security continuously monitors non-human identities (NHIs) and their associated secrets across code repositories, SaaS applications, wikis, and cloud systems. It goes beyond detection by verifying which secrets are live, analyzing their scope of access, and streamlining remediation through automated workflows and lifecycle management so teams can prioritize what to revoke and confirm it's done without manual follow-up.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, Chick-fil-A, and OpenAI, Truffle Security helps security and engineering teams stay ahead of secrets risk.

About the role

This is our first dedicated Revenue Operations leadership hire, and we're going to be honest about what you're walking into.

Our GTM systems and processes work, but they were built reactively as the business grew. There is not yet a cohesive, intentional revenue operations architecture, and that's exactly what we're hiring you to create.

That's the opportunity. You'll own the full GTM operations stack, define what RevOps means at Truffle, and build the function from a strong revenue base rather than a blank page. You'll inherit one Business Systems team member, hire a planned GTM Engineer, and grow the team as the business scales, including standing up functions like deal desk that don't exist today.

We're open on level. Depending on your experience, this role could be Director or VP scope. What matters is that you've built before and want to build again.

What you'll be working on

  • Systems foundation. Your first-year priority. Assess our Salesforce instance and strengthen it into a coherent architecture with clean data, clear definitions, and reporting people actually trust, then bring the surrounding GTM stack into alignment with it.
  • Full GTM operations. Sales ops, marketing ops, and CS ops under one roof. You'll be the connective tissue across the entire revenue funnel, from lead attribution through renewal.
  • Revenue data integrity. One architecture across the stack where records move without corruption, business definitions are enforced in-system, and any number pulled by marketing, sales, finance, or the board reconciles with every other system. When a number is questioned, you are the answer.
  • Deal desk and quoting. Build the function from scratch and own it directly: pricing approvals, quote-to-close workflow, non-standard deal governance, and the guardrails that let AEs move fast without breaking things. At our size this is a process you run, not a team you inherit, with the option to staff it as deal volume grows.
  • Marketing operations infrastructure. Marketing leadership defines the strategy, the programs, and what qualifies as a lead. You own the machinery underneath: the infrastructure that captures, enriches, routes, and nurtures every lead marketing generates, and the measurement layer that ties program spend to pipeline.
  • Compensation design. Own comp plan design and modeling across sales and SDR functions. You'll partner with Finance, who owns administration and payout.
  • Forecasting. Own forecast methodology, cadence, and tooling. Build a forecast that sales leadership and the board trust, and run the operating rhythm behind it.
  • Annual planning. Territory design, capacity planning, and quota setting in partnership with sales leadership and Finance.
  • The GTM tech stack. Full ownership: vendor selection, contracts, budget, and consolidation. If a tool isn't earning its keep, you have the authority to kill it.
  • Process and definitions. Codify the rules of engagement: lead routing, sourcing attribution, opportunity stages, SQL definitions, forecast methodology. Turn tribal knowledge into a documented, enforced process.
  • Team building. Manage and develop our current Business Systems team member, with a GTM Engineer hire planned for this team to build automation and AI-driven workflows across the stack. You'll shape that role, make the hire, and grow the function from there.

What success looks like in year one

  • Salesforce runs on an intentional data model. There is one source of truth: marketing, sales, and finance pull the same numbers and get the same answers
  • Deal desk exists, with documented approval workflows and pricing guardrails in active use.
  • Lead routing, sourcing credit, and qualification definitions are codified and enforced in-system.
  • A forecast methodology is in place and holding up against actuals, with a weekly operating cadence around it.
  • Comp plans are designed, modeled, and documented, with a clean handoff to Finance for administration.
  • Sales leadership spends its time selling and coaching, not reconciling spreadsheets.

Our fiscal year starts February 1, so annual planning is an early deliverable, not a year-end one.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or GTM operations at B2B SaaS companies, with at least 2 years leading the function or a significant piece of it
  • Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise. You've taken an inherited instance and meaningfully improved its architecture, data quality, and reporting, not just administered it
  • You've owned the full architecture across a marketing automation platform and a CRM at a company that scaled, and made the two behave as one system. Our stack: Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Common Room, Nooks, Gong
  • Experience standing up net-new functions (deal desk, marketing ops, CS ops) rather than inheriting mature ones
  • Comp plan design and modeling experience across AE and SDR roles
  • Experience owning forecast methodology and annual planning (territories, capacity, quotas) at a growing sales org
  • Strong analytical chops. You're fluent in pipeline math, conversion analysis, and forecast methodology, and you can defend your numbers to a CEO and a board
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity at an early-stage company. You'll set the strategy and do the work, especially early

Bonus points!

  • Experience in security, developer tools, or open source-driven companies
  • Experience turning open-source adoption signals into an enterprise revenue process. Our funnel starts with hundreds of thousands of daily open source users.
  • Experience supporting channel and partner sales models
  • Exposure to usage-based or seat-based pricing model transitions

Why this role

Most RevOps leaders inherit either a mess with no revenue or a mature machine with no room to build. This is neither. Truffle has real enterprise revenue, marquee logos, a healthy pipeline, and an executive team that knows the operations foundation needs investment and is hiring you to lead it. You'll have a mandate, a seat at the table, and a genuinely interesting business to operate.

Compensation

Salary Range:The target base salary range for this position is between $210,000 to $250,000 for candidates in the United States. Starting salary will vary based on job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. Leveling will be determined during the interview process. You may also be offered a bonus, stock options, and benefits. These salary ranges are subject to change, and we encourage candidates outside of this salary range to apply.

How we support our team

  • Fully remote within the U.S. – We believe opportunity shouldn’t be limited by geography. Our remote-first approach lets us hire the best people across the United States and empowers them to do their best work from wherever they are.
  • A culture of mentorship, equity, and psychological safety – We’re committed to fostering an environment where you can thrive, learn, and feel valued.
  • Competitive salary & meaningful equity – Be rewarded for your contributions with a strong compensation package and a stake in our shared success.
  • Flexible paid time off – We operate with a high level of autonomy and trust, giving you the flexibility to take time off as needed—no strict limits, just the expectation that you’re meeting your commitments and getting your work done.
  • 14 paid holidays – Including Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and "Truffle Holidays" when the entire company takes a well-deserved day off together.
  • Comprehensive health benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 80% of premiums covered for you and your dependents.
  • Remote work stipend – Get set up for success with an $800 new hire stipend and $100/month to keep your workspace comfortable.
  • Health & wellness stipend – $1,200/year to support your physical, mental, and emotional well-being— we believe that feeling good helps you do great work.
  • Learning & development stipend – $2,000/year to invest in your growth, whether it’s courses, certifications, or industry conferences.
  • 401(k) match – We match 100% of the first 6% of your contributions on every paycheck, helping you build financial security for the future.
  • 100% remote + company off-sites – Twice a year, we come together in amazing locations like Hawaii, Cabo, and the Rocky Mountains to collaborate and connect.

We’re looking for folks who are interested in being part of the journey to make the internet more secure. The internet is for all, and we believe that diverse experiences and people from all walks of life can contribute to this mission. That said, if what we’re doing resonates with your values, we’d love to have you apply even if you don’t check all of the boxes or match the job description to a tee.

Truffle strives to promote an equitable, inclusive, and psychologically-safe workplace for all who are interested in working with us. All job applicants will be considered throughout the employment process without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception/identity, age, pregnancy or parental status, disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. If you are an individual with disabilities and reasonable accommodation is needed throughout the interview process, or to perform essential job functions, please let your recruiter know.

Lastly, we ask that all applicants consider the opportunity to answer a few voluntary demographic questions on the job application. This helps us track the inclusivity of our recruiting initiatives. Answering these questions is entirely optional and your answers will not be shared with the hiring team and will not impact the hiring decision.

Note: Our organization participates in the US federal E-Verify program. We will provide the Social Security Administration, and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. We do not use this information to pre-screen job applicants.

Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. This role centers on a comprehensive diagnosis of core business constraints impacting client growth, leveraging a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to identify and formulate strategic solutions. This includes pinpointing challenges across all points of sale - DTC/ecommerce acquisition, retail execution, Amazon market share erosion, or upstream strategic barriers like brand positioning - and developing a unified, data-backed strategy to overcome them.

CPG accounts tend to have opinions about their channels that predate the data. Part of this job is having the product, competitive, and retail fluency to challenge those assumptions with credibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with particular attention to how the client's retail and DTC performance interact
  • Own the senior client relationship
  • QBRs should drive decisions, not report history
  • Consult on channel mix across DTC, Amazon, and retail — understand how they cannibalize or reinforce each other and make a recommendation
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a single account strategy
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
  • Coach analysts and specialists; give specific, timely feedback

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in CPG marketing, ideally with both DTC and retail brand experience

  • Has an opinion on CPG measurement — MMM, incrementality testing, in-store vs. digital attribution
  • Fluent in upper-funnel channel strategy — content, SEO, YouTube, programmatic
