jobs.description:
Category: IT Services

Location: Jacksonville Florida United States


Principal Business Analyst – Operations Transformation - Remote with Travel

Position Summary

The Principal Business Analyst for Operations Transformation will play a key role in the design and implementation of a future-state operating model for a multi-credit-union shared-services organization. This individual will serve as the primary bridge between business operations, technology, data, AI/automation teams, and project leadership. Previous Credit Union experience is a MUST HAVE. Understanding of regulatory and legal issues regarding US financial services and data security requirements affecting credit unions. In particular, please describe your ability to comply with: - Gramm-Leach-Bliley data security and privacy requirements; - SSAE 18, SOC 2 Type 2; 10 | Page - ISO 27001; - NCUA Regulation 748 A & B.

The Senior Business Analyst will lead current-state discovery, process analysis, requirements definition, KPI baselining, future-state process design, and benefits validation, with an initial focus onDeposit Operations. The role will help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, scalability, control, and member experience through workflow orchestration, automation, artificial intelligence, and improved use of institutional knowledge.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and process transformation capabilities with hands-on experience incredit unions, retail banking, or regulated financial-services operations.

Key Responsibilities

Current-State Assessment & Process Discovery

  • Lead structured discovery sessions with credit union and shared-services subject matter experts to understand current business processes, systems, controls, data flows, handoffs, exception paths, and manual activities.
  • Document end-to-end current-state processes using process maps, workflows, business rules, requirements, and supporting analysis.
  • Analyze processes across participating credit unions to identify common workflows as well as institution-specific policies, configurations, and exceptions.
  • Identify process bottlenecks, duplicate activities, manual workarounds, control gaps, rework, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
  • Facilitate interviews and workshops in a manner that encourages candid input from employees and stakeholders impacted by future process changes.

Deposit Operations Analysis

  • Lead detailed analysis of Deposit Operations processes, including areas such as:
    • ACH and share-draft exception processing
    • Returned deposits
    • ACH research and reclamations
    • Manual payroll processing
    • Card and member-account support processing
    • Remote/mobile deposit review
    • Exception and research workflows
  • Evaluate opportunities to automate, augment, or redesign activities using workflow orchestration, AI, document intelligence, robotic process automation, and related technologies.
  • Develop recommendations for prioritizing automation opportunities based on business value, implementation complexity, risk, volume, and readiness.
  • Ensure future-state workflows appropriately address exceptions, escalations, human review, and audit requirements.

Business Requirements & Future-State Design

  • Translate business needs into clear, testable business, functional, data, workflow, integration, reporting, and control requirements.
  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process models, and requirements traceability documentation.
  • Partner with solution architects, developers, AI specialists, security teams, and business SMEs to ensure proposed solutions address operational requirements.
  • Support the design of configurable workflows capable of accommodating multiple credit unions, operating models, systems, policies, and approval structures.
  • Help distinguish requirements best addressed through commercial technology from capabilities that should be incorporated into the strategic orchestration layer.
  • Ensure business requirements consider scalability to additional business lines, including Lending and Collections, and to future participating credit unions.

KPI Baselining & Benefits Realization

  • Establish and validate baseline operating metrics for targeted business processes, including:
    • Transaction and work volumes
    • Manual effort and FTE utilization
    • Cycle time and throughput
    • Error and rework rates
    • Exception rates
    • Cost to serve
    • Service-level performance
  • Partner with business and project leadership to develop credible efficiency and business-benefit estimates.
  • Define measurable success criteria for proposed automation initiatives.
  • Develop a benefits-tracking framework comparing baseline results with post-implementation performance.
  • Analyze realized results and provide fact-based recommendations supporting implementation and expansion decision gates.

Stakeholder & Change Management

  • Serve as a trusted liaison among operations personnel, credit union leadership, technology teams, compliance stakeholders, and implementation teams.
  • Facilitate workshops to validate current-state findings, future-state workflows, requirements, and implementation assumptions.
  • Identify organizational impacts resulting from automation and process redesign.
  • Support change-readiness assessments, communications, training, knowledge transfer, and transition planning.
  • Ensure institutional knowledge and critical business rules currently held by individual employees are identified, documented, and incorporated into future-state processes where appropriate.
  • Maintain a member-service-oriented perspective when evaluating operational changes and automation opportunities.

Risk, Controls & Regulatory Considerations

  • Incorporate operational risk, compliance, privacy, security, and internal-control considerations into business requirements and future-state workflows.
  • Work with compliance and technical teams to ensure requirements appropriately address the regulated credit union environment, including considerations related to GLBA, NCUA expectations, data privacy, auditability, and third-party risk.
  • Identify requirements for human-in-the-loop review, approvals, exception handling, explainability, and audit trails associated with AI-enabled processes.
  • Assist in identifying and documenting operational, process, data, technology, adoption, and implementation risks and associated mitigation actions.

Testing, Implementation & Governance

  • Support solution validation through requirements reviews, prototypes, demonstrations, and user acceptance testing.
  • Develop or support test scenarios and acceptance criteria based on documented business requirements.
  • Coordinate with business stakeholders to validate that implemented workflows meet operational needs before production deployment.
  • Track requirements, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, issues, and scope changes throughout the engagement.
  • Prepare business-analysis deliverables supporting project governance and executive/Board decision gates.
  • Provide clear status, findings, risks, and recommendations to project leadership and client stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible business analysis, business process transformation, or operational improvement experience.
  • Demonstrated experience withincredit unions, retail banking, banking operations, financial-services shared services, or another highly regulated financial-services environment.
  • Experience analyzing complex operational processes involving multiple systems, business units, handoffs, controls, and exception scenarios.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead requirements gathering and process-discovery workshops with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong experience developing:
    • Current- and future-state process maps
    • Business and functional requirements
    • User stories and acceptance criteria
    • Business rules and decision logic
    • KPI and benefits frameworks
    • Requirements traceability matrices
    • Process and data-flow documentation
  • Experience supporting workflow automation, intelligent automation, RPA, AI-enabled transformation, or digital process redesign initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to quantify operational improvement opportunities and measure realized business benefits.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency working with operational, financial, and performance data.
  • Excellent facilitation, interviewing, written communication, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
  • Experience working within Agile, iterative, hybrid, or structured implementation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience withcredit union Deposit Operationsor comparable retail banking operations.
  • Experience with ACH, deposit exceptions, remote deposit capture, payments, card servicing, disputes, reconciliations, or account servicing.
  • Experience working with Credit Union Service Organizations (CUSOs), shared-service organizations, or multi-entity operating environments.
  • Familiarity with core banking, workflow, document-management, payment, and financial-services platforms.
  • Experience supporting AI, generative AI, machine learning, document intelligence, workflow orchestration, or automation implementations.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant operating models and requirements for data and workflow segregation across financial institutions.
  • Understanding of financial-services regulatory and control frameworks, including GLBA and NCUA requirements.
  • Experience supporting technology implementations requiring model governance, human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, or explainability.
  • CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable business-analysis/process-improvement certification preferred.

Key Deliverables

The Senior Business Analyst may be responsible for or contribute materially to the following engagement deliverables:

  • Current-state process inventory and process maps
  • Business capability and operational assessment
  • Deposit Operations process analysis
  • Process-volume, effort, cycle-time, error, and cost baseline
  • Automation opportunity assessment and prioritization
  • Future-state process designs
  • Business, functional, integration, data, reporting, and control requirements
  • Business rules and exception-handling requirements
  • User stories and acceptance criteria
  • Requirements traceability matrix
  • KPI and success-measurement framework
  • Benefits realization model
  • Operational risk and mitigation inputs
  • Organizational impact and change-readiness analysis
  • User acceptance testing scenarios and validation results
  • Decision-gate documentation and implementation recommendations

Success Profile

Success in this role requires an individual who can move comfortably between detailed operational analysis and executive-level business outcomes. The Senior Business Analyst must be able to understand how work is actually performed today, challenge processes constructively, translate operational knowledge into structured requirements, and identify where automation can deliver measurable value without compromising member service, regulatory compliance, or operational control.

The successful candidate will bring aclient-centered, evidence-based approach to transformation, helping the organization build confidence in new AI and automation capabilities while creating processes and requirements that can scale across additional credit unions and business lines.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Supply Chain Senior Manager – Global Supply Chain Lead

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead the end-to-end supply chain for a product portfolio, with a strong focus on reliable patient supply, long-term value, and cross-functional alignment. Working across functions, you will anticipate risks and opportunities, turn insights into clear plans, and enable timely decisions that protect continuity of supply. You will also help shape supply chain and lifecycle choices that strengthen resilience and improve financial performance. The role sits within a multinational and multicultural environment that offers strong opportunities for collaboration, learning, and professional growth.

Responsibilities:

Strategy:

  • Provide thought leadership in shaping end-to-end product supply strategies, orchestrating long-range and monthly planning cycles, and driving business-critical lifecycle management decisions and implementation of product strategies.

  • Ensure every patient, every time by proactively anticipate risks and opportunities, leading cross-functional Supply Chain Teams to develop mitigation plans to protect continuity of supply.

  • Represent Global, Regional, and Site Supply Chain in cross-functional product teams, driving alignment on the end-to-end product supply strategy, key risks, opportunities and lifecycle decisions.

  • Advise on manufacturing site selection, network evaluations and business cases by translating end-to-end supply chain insights and scenarios into clear recommendations that influence supply chain design.

  • Lead and support strategic Global Supply Chain initiatives, including acquisitions, integrations and transformations, to enable continued growth.

Execution:

  • Ensure global demand and supply plans are aligned with the agreed product supply strategy and provide a reliable basis for decision making through the planning cycle.

  • Monitor product supply and inventory performance against agreed targets and guardrails, using metrics and exceptions to identify issues and drive timely corrective actions.

  • Set and maintain appropriate inventory targets and guardrails for assigned products, working with manufacturing sites, network planning and Finance to maintain a healthy supply plan and protect continuity of supply. Consider cost and financial impact in product supply and inventory decisions, while keeping continuity of supply and patient service as key priorities.

  • Maintain an end-to-end understanding of the product supply chain, including lead times, critical raw materials, capacity and other key planning assumptions, and ensure these are reflected in supply decisions.

  • Share and develop best practices across the Global Supply Chain network through initiatives that improve supply chain processes, systems and ways of working.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience OR

  • Master’s degree and 4 years of Supply Chain, Operations directly or related experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of Supply Chain, Operations directly or related experience OR

  • Associate degree and 10 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience OR

  • High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge and experience in applying advanced planning techniques as it relates to demand, supply, inventory planning, financials, and Mfg. network planning.

  • Excellent communication capabilities and must be comfortable and confident dealing with all levels of management within the organization.

  • Strong digital mindset, with demonstrated ability to leverage digital tools, data, and automation to improve supply chain planning insights and decision making.

  • Demonstrated ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes across a matrix organization.

  • 7 plus years of experience in global pharmaceutical, biotech or any other industry.

  • Solid understanding of demand/supply planning, Supply Chain principles and logistics.

  • Ability to perform system-based advanced supply planning and scenario analysis.

  • Diligent with strong business analytical skills and company-wide knowledge.

  • Process-oriented mentality with leadership experience to identify gaps and seek solutions.

  • Perseverance and independent problem-solving skills.

  • Knowledge and understanding of COGM, COGS and NPV analyses.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.description:
HubSpot is looking for a Customer Success Manager who is interested in interested in leading with AI to deliver customer value, build long-lasting relationships, and help customers unlock their full HubSpot potential to achieve their goals. Customer Success Managers are the trusted inbound advisors for each of their customers. They have an intimate understanding of how their businesses work and what the businesses need to grow and thrive. In working with your customers, you will find that no two of them are the same. In the morning, you could be working with the Marketing Manager at a carpet manufacturer about how to rank for the keyword “stain resistant carpet” through more effective blogging. In the afternoon, you could be talking to the CMO of a software company about how to convert more of their free trials into customers through marketing automation and the sales platform.

This role is open in our London Office as well as Remote and Flex in the UK.

In this Role you’ll get to:

  • Manage 150 – 180 customer relationships. Some of your customers will be new while others may have been using HubSpot for several years.
  • Work with your customers on a regular basis to understand their goals and aligning them with the necessary resources to achieve them.
  • Partner with different teams at HubSpot to 'solve for the customer' including onboarding, up-sell/x-sell, and renewals. Along the way, you will get to know HubSpot’s software incredibly well and help your customers fully adopt the platform.
  • Your day-to-day is a mix of proactive and reactive work, and CSMs have a lot of autonomy in managing their “book of business”. The proactive work includes 4-5 scheduled deep-dive meetings per day with customers, where you review their progress, make strategic and tactical recommendations, and keep them up to date on the latest and greatest features from HubSpot. The reactive work runs the gamut from questions about invoices to “how to” questions about the software
  • Promote the growth of your install base by uncovering, scoping and qualifying opportunities where customers can use more Hubspot products and services to ensure customer retention and growth
  • Understand technical roadblocks and make recommendations on solution implementation and core integrations using Hubspot to overcome them

If you’re stimulated by problem solving - whether it’s a business or technical challenge – this is the role for you.

To excel in this role you will need to have:

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing or account management role,
  • Business savvy with consultative, problem solving, and issue resolution skills
  • Strong knowledge of the media/digital landscape
  • Motivated self-starter who is hungry to learn and can provide strong examples of how they have achieved results while balancing demanding expectations
  • Super organised, quick learner who works well under pressure
  • Strong negotiation skills, comfortable navigating financial conversations, and dealing with cancellations
  • It’s easy for you to build and maintain relationships, manage expectations, and identify issues that require escalation
  • Knowledge of Loop Marketing, AEO, and LLM or the aptitude to learn it quickly and independently are required
  • Support an on-going partner relationship to maximise acquisition, retention, and up-sell rates

We know theconfidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Germany Applicants: (m/f/d) - link to HubSpot's Career Diversity page here.

India Applicants: link to HubSpot India's equal opportunity policy here.

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Job Title: Associate Clinical Project Manager - Sponsor Dedicated

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

The SSO Clinical Project Manager (CPM) is accountable for the day-to-day planning,executing, and reporting, (from first site initiation visit to and including study site close-out), of assigned studies in compliance with Sponsor processes and regulatory requirements.

The CPM is the single point of contact and study team lead, in the country/cluster/hub, for the assigned studies. The CPM is responsible for assuring aligned communication with Trial Leads and other CTT members, locally with Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), CRA Managers and other key associates on the execution and progress of their studies. The CPM collaborates with the SSO Country Manager, SSO Country Head, SSO Feasibility Manager, SSO Study Start-up Manager and SSO Site Partnership Manager in the planning, execution, and delivery of their assigned studies. Accountable for execution and reporting of assigned studies in E2E product line Clinical Operations Program Head/Study Lead/CPM – CRA. Can be assigned partially to participate in the review process of Site Monitoring Plans across the Portfolio.

Responsabilities:

  • Supports SSO Study Start-up Manager with the development of country/cluster/hub study execution plans and timeline commitments.
  • Participates with the recruitment sub-team and supports the development of innovative solutions for site and patient participation to ensure the delivery of assigned studies on time
  • Proactively identifies risks and opportunities for the assigned studies in the country/cluster/hub and develops respective mitigation plans
  • Supports study feasibility as requested by the SSO Feasibility Manager by providing input to the study protocol and operational aspects of the study
  • Maintains a strong knowledge of the study protocol to answer standard operational questions from CRAs, sites and Country/Cluster/Hub personnel
  • Drives the conduct of the study (tracks status, maintains relevant reporting systems, oversees forecasts, progress, and mitigation plans) to ensure all study operational aspects are on track
  • Ensures recruitment targets are met and reviews enrollment at the site level including responsibility for obtaining approval from the STUDY LEADER on enrolling above site targets.
  • Responsible to set up contingency plan to ensure recruitment targets are achieved in accordance with trial execution plan
  • Oversees local study team activities to achieve study timelines and quality execution, (proposing and implementing corrective actions where appropriate), according to Sponsor standards and relevant regulations
  • Leads/chairs country/cluster/hub study team meetings, participates in global clinical trial team meetings, as required, and is the single point of contact for the conduct of assigned studies
  • Maintains oversight of country/cluster/hub level data management activities, including timely understanding of screen failure reasons and discontinuation rates, review of patient profiles, and proactively identifies data entry issues (on quality and timing) to mitigate queries, proactively identifies query resolution issues
  • Coordinates the study handover process with CRAs and their managers to ensure proper documentation and communication, when necessary
  • Tracks all study close–out activities and ensures they are performed in a timely manner, in collaboration with CRAs and key study stakeholders
  • Conducts or coordinates training, as needed, for CRAs to support site readiness to recruit and study execution ensuring adherence to clinical data standards, prevailing legislation, GCP, Ethical Committee and SOP requirements
  • Conducts or coordinates local investigator meetings, as needed, and ensures relevant training documentation is archived in the Trial Master File
  • Evaluates potential challenges/risks in the protocol and operational aspects of the study; assesses impacts, develops risk management plans, and communicates/escalates to global teams and SSO Hub Head Portfolio, as appropriate
  • Accountable for monitoring quality and issue resolution through timely review and approval of study monitoring visit reports to ensure quality trial oversight and appropriate issue escalation
  • Promotes a compliance culture advocating the adherence to highest standards and ethical integrity, ensuring human subject protection and reliability of trial results at all times.
  • Acts as the escalation point for issues in monitoring visit reports (MVRs) for the assigned studies.
  • Responsible for evaluating trends identified in MVRs and communicating/escalating these to global teams, as appropriate. Communicates with CRAs and their managers to ensure issue resolution in a timely manner
  • Provides feedback about the quality of monitoring activities to CRA Managers, MSOM, SSO Country Managers, FSP/BiS line managers, as appropriate, and to local QA (when required per Sponsor SOPs)
  • Supports inspection readiness and submission preparation for monitoring-related activities; assists and coordinates with country Portfolio Execution and Quality Assurance for internal audits organization and HA inspections, as required, and ensures implementation of corrective actions within specified timelines.
  • Monitors the status of site budget and contract negotiations as well as the collection and review of essential documents throughout study conduct.
  • Tracks study budget with appropriate study budget in responsible Country. Ensures timely TCF preparation and submission.
  • Processes invoiceable items for site level clinical study activities to allow timely payments
  • Serves as core member of the Global Clinical Trial team as a Country and Hub representative responsible for all local level feedback to the global trial execution teams.
  • Interfaces with SSU teams to ensure on-time initiation of all sites within geography.
  • Interfaces with Country study execution teams, including CRAs and CRA Managers, to ensure on-time recruitment, data delivery, and study close out.

jobs.title: Director Global Transfer Pricing
jobs.excerpt: To manage Transfer Pricing matters of the Group innovatively and strategically, define the Transfer Pricing Policy as well as recommend, advise and implement on solutions for complex transfer pricing projects and topics on a global scale as well as development of SGS Transfer Pricing Model.
jobs.description:
To manage Transfer Pricing matters of the Group innovatively and strategically, define the Transfer Pricing Policy as well as recommend, advise and implement on solutions for complex transfer pricing projects and topics on a global scale as well as development of SGS Transfer Pricing Model. To ensure documentation of all significant international related party transactions across the SGS group of companies including all local and master transfer pricing documentation in accordance with local legislation, OECD guidelines and Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) action plan. To ensure consistency between master file and local file documentation, and to implement a standardised process for the preparation of contemporaneous local transfer pricing documentation. Management of transfer pricing risks within the group including the risk of transfer pricing audit. Advise and support local finance managers and business units on the analysis, design, implementation and execution of Transfer Pricing Policy. Lead a transfer pricing team of currently 6 people in Poland and guide local finance managers on transfer pricing matters.

Purpose of Position:

Global business activities in a MNE require a Global Transfer Pricing Model and Policy which need to be designed, developed, implemented, shaped globally and defended across all countries in which SGS in doing business. The pressure coming from all international developments in the transfer pricing area such as the release of the final BEPS action plan, acceleration of exchange of information among the tax authorities and other transparency initiatives require a position as Head of Global Transfer Pricing. With BEPS it has been introduced a mandatory and legally binding requirement for the completion of transfer pricing documentation across the majority of jurisdictions in which the SGS group operates. Under BEPS Action 13 a three tier approach to transfer pricing documentation is mandated: master file, local file and country by country report. In order to mitigate the risks within the transfer pricing area it will be necessary to establish a standardised documentation process.

Furthermore, as tax authorities will have access to all three tiers of documentation it will be extremely beneficial to maintain a centralised function which can ensure the consistency of documentation and manage any requests for information or audit activity from tax authorities. Standardisation of the documentation process will also result in significant cost savings in relation to the preparation of local documentation as it will not be necessary to engage professional advisers in each jurisdiction to prepare locally compliant documentation.

Key Accountabilities:

Transfer Pricing Documentation Policy

Develop and maintain written policies and procedures relating to Transfer Pricing Documentation activities;

Ensure documentation policy accounts for local deadlines, local documentation requirements and considers all key intra group transactions;

Develop agreed process for transmitting transfer pricing documentation to tax authorities.

Implementation and development of the Transfer Pricing Model

Implement and develop the transfer pricing model of SGS in terms of all transactions covered by SGS group (commercial as well as inter-company) in line with OECD standards including Intellectual property model development, regional costs allocation, TP benchmark studies and Process Contribution Analysis as well as supply chain analysis.

Tax audit support and advise

Manage the process of defending the Transfer pricing set up and model in each country towards the tax authorities incl. tax audits, advanced pricing agreements or any other TP related request. Assist local finance teams in the management of transfer pricing audits by local tax authorities and compile/review transfer pricing information provided to tax authorities.

Lead of the Transfer Pricing team in Poland

Manages and develops the Transfer pricing team by providing vision and strategic leadership and fostering an environment of growth and development within the transfer pricing area. Develop direct report in view of “succession planning”.

Business partnering and support for all business lines and regions in SGS on any transfer pricing question and issue

Build a strong network with our external network partners like tax consultants and manage external stakeholders on transfer pricing questions such as external auditors

Training and communication

Ensure appropriate internal and external training opportunities are available to direct reports;

Provide training to local finance teams and business controllers on transfer pricing model, policy, documentation requirements and their responsibilities in relation to local filing requirements;

Commercial Duties.

Manage team budget and take responsibility for engaging external advisers to provide additional transfer pricing services as required;

Manage performance and facilitate the development of direct reports.

Professional Background & Experience

  • 12–15+ years of experience in Transfer Pricing / International Tax, ideally a mix of:

    • Big 4 (or top-tier advisory firm) – strong technical foundation
    • Multinational company – in-house experience managing global TP models

  • Proven experience in designing and implementing global TP policies and operating models

  • Hands-on involvement in:

    • Master File, Local File, and CbCR (BEPS Action 13)
    • Global documentation standardisation projects
    • Complex TP structures (IP, service models, cost allocation, principal structures)

  • Experience managing transfer pricing audits, APAs, and tax authority negotiations across multiple jurisdictions

  • Exposure to highly regulated, multi-country environments (ideally 50+ jurisdictions)

As part of our recruitment process, we kindly request that you submit your CV in English to ensure accurate evaluation

We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,500 employees operate a network of 2,500 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Cloud Governance Platform team. This team builds the foundational platforms that enforce governance, identity security, compliance, and software supply-chain protections across all of Samsara’s cloud infrastructure and developer environments.

Rather than relying on manual reviews or policy enforcement, this team delivers secure, compliant-by-default systems through cloud IAM guardrails, automated controls, and scalable platform abstractions across AWS and GCP.

As a Senior Engineer you will contribute hands-on to systems that need to be reliable and secure at scale, taking ownership of your components end-to-end.

You will bring strong engineering judgment to design discussions, while looking to senior/staff engineers and your manager for guidance on cross-team tradeoffs.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build core components of Samsara's Cloud Governance Platform, contributing hands-on to cloud IAM, security controls, compliance enforcement, and software supply-chain security capabilities.
  • Contribute to the roadmap for governance and security tooling across AWS and GCP, bringing engineering judgment to prioritization discussions.
  • Translate regulatory and compliance requirements into automated, continuously enforced controls through direct implementation.
  • Build and maintain software supply-chain security tooling, including SAST, DAST, and secure CI/CD pipeline patterns.
  • Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, and Product Engineering teams to implement solutions for cross-functional risk and governance problems.
  • Share technical knowledge with teammates through code reviews, pairing, and day-to-day collaboration.
  • Clearly communicate technical approach, tradeoffs, and risks in design docs and team discussions.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 4+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • Strong programming/coding and design fundamentals (Golang, Python or similar).
  • Deep hands-on expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM systems, threat models, and mitigations.
  • Experience designing and operating highly reliable, scalable distributed systems.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to influence without direct authority.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or governance systems used across many teams.
  • Background in developer tools, infrastructure, or productivity engineering.
  • Experience with software supply-chain security practices and tooling.
  • Proficiency in Golang, Python, Terraform, or similar platform-focused technologies.
  • Strong judgment in balancing developer experience, platform adoption, and enforcement of security controls.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$142,800—$184,800 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About the RoleAs Senior Analyst/Manager, Incentive Programs at Astrana Health, you will own the tracking, quantification, and reporting of performance and earned revenue across the health plan incentive programs in which Astrana participates, spanning Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial, Exchange, and ACO populations.
These programs are a material and growing share of Astrana's earned revenue, but terms, measure sets, payout curves, and data requirements differ by plan, line of business, and market. This role brings one quantified view to that landscape: what dollars are available, what we are on pace to earn, what we are at risk of leaving on the table, and where an incremental unit of operational effort produces the greatest return.

What You'll Do

Incentive Program Inventory & Revenue Opportunity Modeling
  • Maintain a current inventory of health plan incentive programs across all lines of business, including measure sets, payout structures, attainment thresholds, gates, data requirements, and payment timelines
  • Translate contract and program terms into a quantified revenue opportunity model at the plan, market, IPA, and measure level, and maintain a running view of dollars available, earned to date, and still achievable
  • Quantify the marginal value of each incremental gap closed so effort and spend can be directed toward the highest yield measures
Performance Monitoring & Measure Prioritization
  • Monitor performance against payout thresholds throughout the year, with attention to measures sitting near a tier boundary in either direction
  • Identify high value measures using dollar weight, distance to threshold, denominator size, remaining runway, and feasibility, and set internal targets tied to payout tiers rather than generic benchmarks
  • Provide early warning when projected performance will miss a threshold, while there is still time to intervene
Executive Reporting, Forecasting & Risk Identification
  • Produce monthly executive reporting covering year to date performance and revenue earned, projected year end performance and revenue, and change versus prior month and prior year with drivers
  • Build dashboards and recurring reporting that are legible without an analyst present, and present findings, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and in board, health plan, and market reviews
  • Maintain a consistent, documented, auditable projection methodology so month over month movement reflects real performance change rather than methodology drift
  • Surface the largest revenue opportunities and downside risks with quantified impact, a recommended owner, and a recommended action, and track them to resolution
  • Reconcile Astrana's internal performance view against health plan reported results, investigate variances, and identify systemic causes including missing supplemental data, encounter submission gaps, attribution errors, and measure logic misalignment
Cross-Functional Strategy & Data Management
  • Partner with the Chief Quality Officer and the President of Physician Enterprise to inform strategy and resource allocation across Quality, Utilization and Care Management, Encounter Submission, and Member Experience
  • Support health plan contract negotiation with analysis of historical performance, achievability of proposed thresholds, and expected value under alternative terms
  • Ingest, normalize, and reconcile data from plan reports, portal extracts, flat files, claims and encounter data, EMR feeds, and vendor files into repeatable, documented pipelines
  • Establish data quality checks and reconciliation controls, document known data limitations, and partner with data engineering on durable reporting infrastructure as the function scales

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, public health, health policy, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years (Senior Analyst) or 5+ years (Manager) of analytic experience in a health plan, IPA, MSO, or provider organization
  • Working knowledge of HEDIS and Medicare Stars measure specifications, including administrative, supplemental, and hybrid data sources
  • Familiarity with value-based care economics: pay-for-performance, shared savings, withholds, and capitated risk
  • Strong SQL and advanced Excel, working independently against large and imperfect datasets
  • Demonstrated experience building recurring executive reporting and translating analysis into a defensible recommendation
  • Comfort with ambiguity in source data, the judgment to know when a number is good enough to act on, and the discipline to state the confidence level
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with senior executives, and the accountability to manage multiple concurrent reporting cycles
Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct experience with Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, Medicaid quality withhold or incentive programs, or ACO REACH and MSSP quality reporting
  • Experience reconciling internal performance calculations against health plan reported results, and reading and operationalizing health plan incentive contract language
  • Proficiency with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and with Python or R

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S. The home office is located at 1668 S. Garfield Ave. 2nd Floor, Alhambra, CA 91801.
  • This role is required to attend occasional in-person meetings with internal departments or health plan partners.
  • The national target pay range for this role is between $90,000 - $130,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

The Group Director, Lifestyle is Power Digital's senior client relationship and revenue leader for consumer product brands operating primarily through traditional D2C ecommerce but also available through other sales channels.. Your clients compete on a longer, higher-consideration purchase journey — a single sale can carry months of nurture, multiple touchpoints, and a meaningful financial commitment from the customer, and you manage your portfolio the way a fund manager runs a book: you know which accounts compound, which CAC payback economics are drifting, and exactly where to spend your time. You are the executive a client calls when payback period stretches out or a consideration-heavy funnel starts leaking, and the leader an Account Director never wants to let down. The roles you consistently play day-to-day are: portfolio growth owner, talent multiplier, tech forward leader and AI systems thinker.

At Power, retention is the floor, not the job. You are commercially driven first: you personally own executive relationships and expansion revenue for the top of your portfolio, and you hold your team to the same standard. In Lifestyle, that means staying closer to consideration-cycle length, CAC payback period, and the balance between paid acquisition efficiency and brand/content investment than almost any other Group Director role requires — because in this vertical, a shift in any of those shows up in a client's D2C economics before it shows up in a quarterly plan. You coach Account Directors and their teams to operate as AI-Native Growth Directors — faster, sharper, and less buried in manual work than the role has ever required before. You decide which AI tools and workflows the division adopts. Your influence runs beyond Client Experience: you shape your Division's go-to-market position, you're a thought partner to your Managing Director and VP, and you represent Power Digital in market on Lifestyle and higher-AOV D2C strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion MRR for the division; treat expansion as the primary commercial lever of the role and own the division's monthly service expansion target
  • Personally own executive relationships across the top 30–40% of the portfolio by MRR — direct relationship, not delegated
  • Run monthly, relationship-focused executive check-ins with top-tier accounts and 1x1 check-ins with every priority account
  • Maintain an accurate, self-owned retention forecast on a weekly basis — accountable for the accuracy of the division's retention data
  • Track vertical-specific marketing signal such as CAC payback period, average order value trends, and consideration-cycle length/multi-touch conversion paths, since a shift in any of these shows up in a client's D2C economics before it shows up in a QBR
  • Diagnose risk early and install fixes, not just responses; lead or co-lead quarterly plans for the top 10% of the portfolio, weighted toward strategic outcomes over metrics recaps
  • Personally review and support all expansion proposals across priority partnerships before client delivery
  • Partner with Account Directors to build value-based, consultative business cases — expansion should drive value, not be sold
  • Identify and lead common Lifestyle expansion paths, including financing/BNPL program integration, email/SMS and lifecycle expansion suited to longer consideration cycles, and content/brand-building investment to support premium positioning
  • Keep the Salesforce pipeline current and accurate — stages, forecast, and next steps updated weekly
  • Serve as the frontline for product and vertical innovation, feeding client signal into Power Circuit
  • Build and evolve vertical-relevant reporting frameworks for Lifestyle, including metrics such as CAC payback period, LTV over a longer purchase cycle, and blended AOV
  • Lead or play a key leadership role in final-round pitches for prospective clients where support is needed (e.g. $25k+)
  • Bring vertical point of view and executive credibility to new business
  • Partner with Sales to sharpen positioning, collateral, and win rate for the division's go-to-market
  • Directly manage Account Directors and oversee the Associate Account Director pod that supports them
  • Coach every direct report to operate as an AI-Native Growth Director, not a task manager — faster diagnosis, more client-facing time, less manual reporting
  • Evaluate the team on Pulse sentiment, health scores, and expansion weekly — not just activity
  • Raise the floor on AI adoption — no one on the team operates the old way
  • Own hiring, staffing, capacity, and career pathing for the division; facilitate DAPs and career progression conversations
  • Practice radical candor; deliver timely, actionable feedback that accelerates careers
  • Identify and develop key talent for future Sr. Account Director & Group Director roles
  • Lead training on vertical-specific and AI-native tools, processes, and strategies
  • Vibe-codes prototypes to automate repeatable tasks, surface better insights, and test hypotheses quickly
  • Designs AI workflows for the team — builds the system, not just uses the tools; models AI-forward behavior
  • Runs Omega and Iris across the full portfolio and acts on the patterns they surface
  • Decides which AI tools and workflows get adopted, when, and how across the division
  • Owns division-level AI quality tradeoffs — where AI accelerates output, and where it must never touch client-facing work unreviewed
  • Builds and evolves Power Circuit solutions specific to the division with AI-assisted research; runs a monthly audit to confirm adoption
  • Collaborates with the innovation team on enhancements and optimizations that better serve the division's clients
  • Consulted on the division P&L and accountable for the profitability of the portfolio
  • Forecast the four pillars — Churn, Service Expansion, New Business, Efficiency — in partnership with the MD and VP
  • Use the P&L and strategic growth bets to build the business case for headcount and investment; drive efficiency through technology, AI, and process improvement
  • Own resolution of every escalation in the direct portfolio
  • Partner with Data Intelligence, Media Planning, and Activation teams to keep strategy and execution connected
  • Represent Power Digital in market — speaking, content, and client-facing points of view
  • Become the internal knowledge hub other leaders turn to for vertical and division expertise

Role Requirements

  • Department leadership and management experience required — has led Account Directors or senior marketers as direct reports
  • 10+ years of leadership experience in a digital marketing agency, with D2C client work in higher-AOV or durable goods categories at the AD level or above
  • Experience managing a P&L for profitable growth
  • Deep marketing fluency in higher-consideration D2C purchase journeys — multi-touch attribution, CAC payback period economics, and the balance between paid acquisition efficiency and brand/content investment; understands where that connection breaks down and how to fix it structurally
  • Channel and program strategy expertise — has built or overseen full-funnel D2C programs (paid social, paid search, email/SMS and lifecycle, content) built for longer consideration cycles, not just supervised execution
  • Measurement expertise: CAC payback period and LTV modeling for higher-AOV, lower-frequency purchase patterns, where standard last-click or short-attribution-window models mislead, and how to present alternative methodologies to a skeptical CFO or finance stakeholder
  • Familiarity with financing and BNPL integration and how it affects conversion and AOV economics
  • Has presented to and pushed back on C-suite and VP stakeholders when the data supported it — can hold a credible, data-backed conversation with a skeptical brand or finance executive about marketing's role in a longer consideration cycle
  • Expertise in contract negotiation, client retention, and client growth
  • Proven track record delivering high NPS and retention metrics across a portfolio
  • Extensive knowledge of owned, earned, and paid marketing channels — content, SEO, paid search, paid social, programmatic, and email/lifecycle
  • Familiarity with Lifestyle-specific platforms and tools: D2C ecommerce platforms (Shopify and similar), email/SMS and lifecycle marketing platforms, financing/BNPL integrations, and LTV/CAC analytics tools
  • Entrepreneurial spirit — energized by building, not just operating; contributes to product and go-to-market strategy, not just client management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Secondary Expectations:

Most Important Things (MITs)

Benefits & Perks:

As an Project Manager at Wanstor, you’ll lead cross-functional teams to deliver technology initiatives that directly impact the business. About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Experimentation team.

The Experimentation team is building one of the company’s most strategic product areas: a platform that helps leading engineering organizations move beyond intuition and make product decisions with real statistical confidence.

Sitting at the intersection of large-scale systems, data science, and user experience, the team is creating a best-in-class experimentation product that lets customers set up, manage, and analyze experiments with ease while still earning the trust of even the most rigorous data teams.

From warehouse-native analysis to experimentation workflows built on top of LaunchDarkly’s massive feature management scale, this team is tackling ambitious technical problems with visible customer impact and a clear opportunity to define the future of modern software experimentation.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design and operate the services that power this product, contribute to technical direction, and help deliver new functionality to customers.

You will work closely with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers across LaunchDarkly to solve complex, data-intensive problems with meaningful customer impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs that power LaunchDarkly’s Experimentation product.
  • Own backend components across their lifecycle, including technical discovery, design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement.
  • Build and evolve systems supporting experiment setup, event data ingestion, metric computation, results processing, and results presentation.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical proposals, making thoughtful trade-offs around scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, data scientists, and adjacent engineering teams to translate customer needs and product goals into reliable technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with Data Platform, Warehouse Integrations, SDK, and other teams on shared data flows, services, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes.
  • Improve observability, testing, deployment safety, operational processes, and the reliability of the systems you build.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation and take ownership of production systems in a you-build-it-you-run-it culture.
  • Support teammates through thoughtful code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and informal mentorship.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building and operating backend services in production.
  • Fluency using AI tools in software engineering workflows, including the judgment to direct, evaluate, and validate AI-generated output.
  • Experience designing and delivering customer-facing systems that are scalable, reliable, observable, and maintainable.
  • Strong programming experience in Go or a comparable backend language such as Python, Rust, or C++. Our team is using Go.
  • Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, APIs, data modeling, or data-intensive services.
  • Familiarity with analytical, operational, or warehouse data stores such as ClickHouse, Postgres, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience diagnosing production issues and improving system reliability through metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and other observability practices.
  • Experience working in a cloud environment and with infrastructure-as-code or equivalent deployment and operations tooling.
  • Ability to take an ambiguous problem from discovery and scoping through design, implementation, launch, and ongoing operation.
  • Clear, thoughtful communication and a collaborative approach to working with technical and non-technical partners.
  • Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, analytics, data platforms, or similarly data-intensive products.

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $191,800 - $263,670**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $172,600 - $237,270**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

NeueHealth is a value-driven healthcare company grounded in the belief that all health consumers are entitled to high-quality, coordinated care. By uniquely aligning the interests of health consumers, providers, and payors, we help to make healthcare accessible and affordable to all populations across the ACA Marketplace, Medicare, and Medicaid.

NeueHealth delivers clinical care to health consumers through our owned clinics – Centrum Health and Premier Medical – as well as unique partnerships with affiliated providers across the country. We also enable providers to succeed in performance-based arrangements through a suite of technology and services scaled centrally and deployed locally. Through our value-driven, consumer-centric approach, we are committed to transforming healthcare and creating a better care experience for all.

This position will work with and support our Oracle Financials and Oracle Enterprise Performance Management business teams. This role will provide day-to-day support and drive the strategic delivery and roadmap for Accounting, Finance, Planning, Reconciliation, and Enterprise Data Management workstreams. This position requires both functional and technical aptitude to be successful, including experience supporting Oracle Financials and Oracle EPM Cloud applications such as Account Reconciliation Cloud Service, Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service, and Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, Accounting, Finance, Process and Technology, and IT technical teams to ensure successful delivery, operational support, process optimization, and system enhancements.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with business financial stakeholders to understand analytics, accounting, reconciliation, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and enterprise data management needs; develop plans to address those needs; and deliver solutions that support business objectives.
  • Provide functional and technical support for Oracle Financials and Oracle EPM Cloud applications, including ARCS, EPBCS, and EDMCS.
  • Support Oracle EPM processes including account reconciliations, transaction matching, planning and budgeting cycles, forecasting, reporting, metadata management, hierarchy maintenance, data governance, and integration support.
  • Partner with Accounting and Finance teams to support ARCS processes including reconciliation compliance, profiles, formats, match types, data loads, period close activities, dashboards, reporting, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis teams to support EPBCS processes including planning forms, business rules, calculations, data maps, reporting, security, scenario/version management, and annual budget and forecast cycles.
  • Support EDMCS processes including enterprise metadata governance, hierarchy and dimension management, request workflows, subscriptions, mappings, validations, and integrations with Oracle Financials, EPM, and downstream systems.
  • Support and understand integrations in and out of Oracle Financials and Oracle EPM applications, including data loads, extracts, metadata integrations, automation processes, and reconciliation between source and target systems.
  • Lead and facilitate business analysis and requirements development and management processes, including eliciting, documenting, analyzing, modeling, prioritizing, validating, and tracing requirements.
  • Lead IT test procedures, prepare test plans, test cases, and scripts, and facilitate system integration testing and user acceptance testing for Oracle Financials and Oracle EPM enhancements, releases, and projects.
  • Collaborate with product partners, system owners, and subject matter experts to gather requirements for new systems, enhancements, integrations, reports, dashboards, and projects within the functional area.
  • Lead design sessions and prototype new systems, enhancements, and projects for the purpose of improving business processes, automation, controls, data quality, and information flow.
  • Document and diagram existing and future-state system and business processes related to Oracle Financials, ARCS, EPBCS, EDMCS, integrations, reporting, and close/planning cycles.
  • Translate functional business requirements into technical requirements while working with system architects, software engineers, integration teams, managed service providers, and Oracle support partners.
  • Collaborate with business and technology partners to perform cost-benefit and return on investment analyses for proposed systems, enhancements, and process improvements to aid management in making implementation decisions.
  • Ensure compatibility, interoperability, security, and data integrity of enhancements and projects within current system and business processes.
  • Monitor Oracle Cloud updates and releases, assess business impact, coordinate testing, and support adoption of new features and capabilities across Oracle Financials and Oracle EPM applications.
  • Support reporting and analytics needs across Oracle Financials and Oracle EPM, including operational reporting, reconciliation reporting, planning and forecast reporting, and executive-level financial reporting.
  • Support Oracle Narrative Reporting capabilities as needed; experience with Narrative Reporting is preferred but not required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, accounting, finance, information systems, or related business field required.
  • 5 years of experience providing support for Oracle Financials, ERP, or Oracle Cloud applications.
  • Experience supporting Oracle EPM Cloud applications required, with specific experience in one or more of the following:
    • Account Reconciliation Cloud Service
    • Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service

jobs.description:
Founding GTM Intern — AI SaaS Research & Outbound

Synvolv is building the control layer for profitable AI products.

AI SaaS companies are launching copilots, agents, RAG workflows, AI support systems, and automation features faster than ever. But once real customers start using these features, a serious business problem appears: AI usage becomes unpredictable, model costs become harder to control, and product margins can quietly break.

Synvolv helps B2B SaaS companies run customer-facing AI with better visibility, usage control, budget discipline, routing, attribution, and margin protection.

We are opening one founding GTM internship seat for someone who wants to work directly with the founders and help build Synvolv’s early go-to-market motion from zero.

This is not a normal internship.

This is for someone who wants to learn how an early technical startup finds its market, identifies buyers, creates pipeline, runs founder-led sales, and turns raw market signals into real customer conversations.

Role Details

Title: Founding GTM Intern — AI SaaS Research & Outbound

Team: Founder’s Office / GTM

Location: Remote — India

Type: Internship
Mode: Remote
Compensation: Paid internship with performance-linked upside for sourced customers. Details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

What You Will Work On

You will help Synvolv find the right AI SaaS companies, understand their AI workflows, map the right buyers, prepare sharp outreach, and support founder-led customer conversations.

Your work will include:

  • AI SaaS market mapping

  • ICP research

  • Buyer discovery

  • Account scoring

  • Founder-led outbound preparation

  • Company briefs before calls

  • CRM discipline

  • Reply and objection tracking

  • Competitor and positioning research

  • GTM experiments

  • Market intelligence

You will not be judged by how many rows you add to a spreadsheet.

You will be judged by the quality of your thinking, the sharpness of your research, and your ability to help create real customer conversations.

The Market You Will Study

You will research companies building or launching:

  • AI copilots

  • AI agents

  • AI support products

  • RAG and docs AI

  • AI workflow automation

  • AI analytics

  • AI-first SaaS products

  • B2B SaaS products adding customer-facing AI features

Your job is to understand where Synvolv may matter.

Not every AI company is a fit. You will learn how to identify companies where AI cost, usage control, routing, attribution, budgets, or margin protection could become a real business problem.

What Good Work Looks Like

You should be able to look at a company’s website, product pages, docs, job posts, founder posts, launch announcements, and LinkedIn profiles — then figure out:

  • What is this company building?

  • Where is AI used in the product?

  • Is the AI customer-facing?

  • Who owns this problem internally?

  • Why would Synvolv matter to them?

  • What signal suggests they may care now?

  • What should we say to start a serious conversation?

This role is not about copy-pasting AI output.

It is about judgment.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone unusually sharp, curious, and high-ownership.

You may be a student. You may not have formal work experience. That is fine.

But you must have hunger, taste, discipline, and the ability to learn fast.

You should be:

  • Curious about AI, SaaS, startups, and GTM

  • Good at internet research

  • Comfortable going deeper than surface-level information

  • Able to write clearly in English

  • Comfortable using ChatGPT and modern internet tools

  • Interested in founder-led sales and early customer discovery

  • Disciplined with data and follow-ups

  • Willing to handle ambiguity

  • Serious about learning how startups actually find customers

This Role Is For You If

  • You want to work close to founders

  • You want real startup exposure, not just a certificate

  • You enjoy research, writing, markets, and buyer psychology

  • You want to understand how technical AI products go from MVP to market

  • You want your work to connect directly to customer acquisition

  • You can handle unclear problems and still make progress

  • You want to build proof that you helped create early GTM for an AI startup

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You only want a title

  • You only want a certificate

  • You need constant instructions for every small task

  • You copy-paste AI output without thinking

  • You are careless with data

  • You are scared of sales or rejection

  • You do not like research-heavy work

  • You want a slow corporate internship

What You Will Learn

You will learn how early-stage GTM actually works.

You will learn:

  • How to define an ICP

  • How to find high-fit accounts

  • How to identify technical and business buyers

  • How to write personalized outbound

  • How founder-led sales works

  • How to prepare customer call briefs

  • How to track objections and market signals

  • How to maintain CRM discipline

  • How to convert research into pipeline

  • How a technical AI product moves from MVP to market

This is a role for someone who wants to become a founder, GTM operator, startup generalist, sales leader, product marketer, or early-stage builder.

Selection Process

We are not hiring from resumes alone.

The selection process will include:

  1. Application review

  2. Practical GTM challenge

  3. GTM judgment interview

  4. Founder pressure-test interview

Shortlisted candidates will receive a practical challenge designed to test research depth, judgment, writing, buyer mapping, commercial thinking, and ownership.

We are looking for one person who can prove they deserve the seat.

How To Apply

Apply through this page.

Please share:

  • Who you are

  • Why this role at Synvolv interests you

  • One AI SaaS company Synvolv should study or target, and why

  • One proof of work you want us to evaluate

  • Your LinkedIn profile

  • One additional link you want us to see, if available

We review applications manually.

We are not selecting based on resumes alone. We are looking for clear thinking, research instinct, ownership, and genuine interest in AI SaaS, startups, and GTM.
